entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.

I can certainly look into that return for you. I'll just need your account information to pull up the order. But first, to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Don't play games with me. I don't need to be diagnosed. I bought it about a month ago, I hate it, and I want to return it. End of story. Are you going to process this or do I need to speak to your manager right now?
No, no, I can absolutely help you, sir. I just need to follow the process. Let me just pull up your purchase date... Okay, I see you received it on December 20th.

That's right. So what's the problem? Are you going to tell me it's **too late**? That your brilliant new **policy** is to rip people off? What are you worried about, **hygiene**? Some issue with **sanitation**? I barely wore the thing!

Sir, please, let me check. I'm just looking at the official policy right now. One moment... Okay. Yes, I apologize for any confusion. Our VeloFit company policy clearly states a 90-day return window for items in their original condition.

Since you received it just under 30 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. It's not too late at all. I can process that full refund for you right now. My sincerest apologies for the frustration.
See? Was that so hard? I knew it. Unbelievable. Fine, just do it. Send me the return label.

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. The prepaid shipping label is on its way to your email address on file right now. And for the trouble and the negative experience today, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future VeloFit purchase. We do value you as a VIP customer.
Whatever. Just make sure that label shows up. Thanks.
It's on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
